import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Wait for the page to load after previous navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Click on the 'Products' link in the menu that appeared after clicking 'Catalog'
    # From the tree, it's under menubar -> menu -> menu -> link 'Products'
    products_link = page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('menu').get_by_role('menu').get_by_role('link', name='Products')
    await products_link.click()
    
    # Wait for navigation to the products page
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Additional wait for dynamic content
    
    # Stop here; further actions will be handled in the next step
    return
